about: EE RAM regions that differ between PCSX2 and the port at the same event for a known reason (tools/pcsx2_compare/loaded_data.py, docs/plans/validation/PCSX2_COMPARISON_PLAN.md, step 5). start and end in hex, end exclusive. The session's patched call words are read from its session.json.

regions.name: kernel
regions.reason: The EE kernel's memory: PCSX2 runs the BIOS kernel there, the port answers the kernel natively and keeps its state in the runtime.

regions.name: display lists A
regions.reason: One of the two display-list buffers the frames alternate between; before a fight's first frame it holds the previous screen's lists (2026-11-12: PCSX2's title demo, none after the port's starter).

regions.name: display lists B
regions.reason: The other display-list buffer, as A.

regions.name: stream buffer
regions.reason: A 416 KB heap block at the same place in both, filled by streaming during the fight (2026-11-12: full in PCSX2 at the fight's first frame, filled in the port by frame 600); its contents follow when the reads land.

regions.name: ADX stream buffer (port)
regions.reason: An ADX stream's buffer (a CRI header at its start) the port's run had in use at the event, PCSX2's run another (below): which buffer of the pool is current follows the stream's timing.

regions.name: ADX stream buffer (PCSX2)
regions.reason: The pool's buffer PCSX2's run had in use, as above.

regions.name: main stack
regions.reason: The top of RAM holds the main thread's stack: words left by earlier calls differ by route and timing.

regions.name: session stubs
regions.reason: The comparison session's stubs, their data and rings, in the region the game leaves empty (session.py).
